name: Article Card
summary: Blog post card with 5 variants: standard, featured, minimal, horizontal, editorial.

anatomy.name: metadataSeparator
anatomy.description: Optional visual separator between metadata values.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Article title heading and destination link.

anatomy.name: authorName
anatomy.description: Author name within the author composition.

variants.name: featured
variants.description: Responsive featured card with side-by-side media and body on wider viewports.

variants.name: minimal
variants.description: Text-led card with media hidden and a bottom divider.

variants.name: horizontal
variants.description: Compact media-and-body row that stacks on narrow viewports.

variants.name: editorial
variants.description: Editorial title treatment using the accent typeface.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Fluid size controlled by the parent layout.

states.name: hover
states.description: Card lift and media zoom on hover-capable targets.

states.name: linkFocus
states.description: Visible keyboard focus for article destinations.

states.name: skeletonPresentation
states.description: Existing placeholder presentation; public ownership remains unresolved.

behavior.name: articleNavigation
behavior.description: Media and title links navigate to the same target-owned article destination.

behavior.name: targetMetadata
behavior.description: Dates, reading time, taxonomy, and author data are formatted and supplied by the target.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Article card presentation supported by canonical CSS.

properties.name: href
properties.description: Article destination shared by the media and title links.

properties.name: media
properties.description: Target-owned article image or media composition.

properties.name: imageAlt
properties.description: Alternative text when the article image conveys information beyond the adjacent title.

properties.name: metadata
properties.description: Target-owned publication date, reading time, or taxonomy metadata.

accessibility: Use semantic article and heading markup, with separate media and title links rather than wrapping all card content in one link.
Provide useful image alternative text when media adds information; use an empty alt value when the linked image only duplicates the adjacent article title.
Preserve visible keyboard focus and do not rely on hover motion to communicate the destination.

shopify.notes: Should map Shopify article, blog, image, author, and publication metadata.
